scope: Secondary empirical RSMI application. Fit only index 9 native training counts. Read no configurations, validation arrays, transfer arrays or test fold. Bank row multiplicity is the sampling design, not a count of independent samples. Previously archived comparators and historical RG operator are fixed initializations/controls, not refitted decoders.
channel: V is the eight-site ternary 2x2x2 tile (6561 possibilities); H=f(V) has 4 nominal labels. Uniform registered orientation J=(-z,+z,-y,+y,-x,+x) is given to the face decoder but not the encoder. Y is a four-site microscopic ternary face (81 words), not a neighboring H. Maximize I(H;Y|J) in bits per single face, not the MI with a joint six-face environment. All maps see exactly the same physical exterior.
smoothing: In each of six count tables add one pseudo-observation per V, distributed over Y as its train direction marginal with half a count per face word. Equal oriented row totals imply V and J are independent. An unobserved V receives a positive prior weight and direction-marginal channel. Also report raw unsmoothed train diagnostics; never select on those or on validation.
energy: I(V;Y|J)-I(H;Y|J) is the expectation of the KL from the full tile channel to the cluster centroid. Batch assignment maximizes the fixed-centroid log score pointwise; aggregating counts is the exact centroid update. Thus energy cannot increase. Original RSMI-NE is one start, not presumed optimal for this different exterior. Training metrics are not held-out performance.
affine: Conventional competitor: four affine logits of 16 additive on-site species indicators, eight for A then eight for B (vacancy reference), plus intercept. No site-site product, arbitrary category lookup, or decoder input to the deployed encoder. Fit to the common physical face channel. Deterministic starts: physical tetrahedral A-dipole; weighted additive least-squares distillation of historical labels; additive projection of three leading standardized train channel modes with tetrahedral logits. Projected start weights are rescaled to integer coefficients. In each sweep fit the physical face decoder, then visit intercept/site coefficients in fixed class/feature order. For each coordinate solve its exact hard-assignment fixed-decoder step over all integer thresholds (including ties under first-label argmax); retain only strictly positive gains. Refit centroids after the sweep. This is not a generic hyperparameter search, and conditional maximization of the variational score does not certify even the best affine decision boundary.
discrete: Deterministic starts: archived rsmi, archived kmeans_A_dipole, full spectral projection, and train-winning affine LUT (nested feasible family). Spectral coordinates use three top eigenvectors of the centered, inverse-square-root-face-frequency-scaled channel under smoothed tile weights; maximal absolute loading is made positive. Split by closest tetrahedral direction. Lloyd ties retain current label; a missing centroid forecasts the marginal, allowing revival. A solution with any zero empirical-mass state is ineligible. Stop when assignments are fixed (for affine, no improving coordinate); cap each start at 256 sweeps and explicitly flag cap. Training objective monotonicity is checked. No global claim.
selection: Per family choose highest smoothed training I among four-populated final maps; exact ties go to first declared start. Save both deployable LUTs (discrete_lut, affine_lut) and per-start maps with distinct non-_lut names. Training log records initial/final objectives and trajectory, mass and collapse, and fitted coefficients. Estimated rate H(H|J)=H(H)=I(V;H|J) of this deterministic encoder is not the nominal fixed two-bit cost. H(H|Y,J) measures unused code entropy relative to this particular face, not a different cost.
distillation: Use empirical cold train frequencies, ignoring unseen tiles. For each discrete symbol tabulate composition and signed A,B moments along z,y,x (face-zero half minus face-one half). Summarize sufficiency of (nA,nB), signed A dipole, and A dipole plus composition by sector-majority agreement and fraction of H entropy explained; list sector counts by symbol. Fit an additive weighted least-squares readout of the discrete labels; report reconstruction confusion, explained one-hot variance and accuracy. Also report optimal permutation alignment to historical and affine symbols; label numbers alone have no physical significance.
reporting: Optimization and interpretation are cold-training diagnostics conditional on this finite channel, not validation evidence, uniqueness, or a global solution of RSMI. All held-out decoders/score contrasts are specified separately. No warm tuning or reselection.
